shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating geometric pattern (chevrons/zigzag)
justification: Both are low-relief stone surfaces on which profile creatures with beaked heads are set against or beneath a horizontal band of repeating geometric ornament, and both include plant- or branch-like motifs. But A is a single large, densely detailed dominant figure filling the whole field with fine incised feather and textile patterning, whereas B distributes small, crudely modelled, flattened silhouettes across stacked registers of a rough pillar, so the compositional logic and level of finish are quite different.
